## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX-pose full-body transparent sprite sheet for a miniature chess victory animation, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Primary request: an ORIGINAL armored lightning knight with a large square-headed war hammer. Fully transparent RGBA background; absolutely no scenery, smoky backdrop, haze, glow clouds, floor, ground shadows, labels or grid. One complete identical character per cell, generous transparent margins, no overlapping silhouettes. Elegant realistic painted fantasy game miniature, detailed silver and charcoal plate armor, restrained antique-gold trim, short deep cobalt-blue cape, closed steel helmet with a narrow visor, leather gauntlets and boots, blue gemstone in the hammer head. Heroic sturdy believable anatomy, readable at 130px tall, refined and noble rather than monstrous. Not a recognizable existing movie or comic character. Fixed three-quarter side profile facing RIGHT. Two arms, two legs, one head, one hammer held naturally with BOTH hands. Keep armor, equipment, scale, camera, body position and common boot baseline consistent. Top row: (1) standing guard, hammer held low diagonally right; (2) one forward step, cape slightly moving, hammer low; (3) beginning to lift hammer overhead with both hands. Bottom row: (4) hammer fully lifted overhead, poised to strike; (5) powerful downward strike to the RIGHT, hammer head out in front at knee height, both hands firmly gripping the shaft; (6) relaxed upright victory stance with hammer held safely upright by the side. Entire hammer, cape, helmet and boots inside their own cell. Solid hard-edged crystal in hammer head, no loose sparks or lightning: the app adds those separately. Preserve true transparent empty space between every figure. Prefer 1536x1024 landscape.
